outcome.technical: Added _outcome_problems() and _tests_add_empty_problem() to plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/_filed_returns.py, wired into _executor_problems(body, task=None) (now threading task through from return_problems), so an executor return is refused before the red-first helper runs or anything is written whenever: (a) outcome.technical/outcome.descriptive is under a stated 12-character floor, carries a template word (placeholder/TODO/TBD) or an unfilled <...>, or the two fields are identical; (b) testsAdded is [] while the task's tests.mode is tdd/regression and tests.add is non-empty - naming the field. drive-phase.py needed no change: its submit() already calls _fr.return_problems(role, body, task) before the stamp is taken or the helper runs, so the new checks apply there automatically. Added test cases rp13/rp14 in test__filed_returns.py (covering the placeholder/identical/floor and testsAdded-empty shapes, plus the allow twins: a real sentence, a filed case, and a gate-only task with no tests.add asked nothing), and ds5p/ds5q in test_drive_phase.py (a placeholder outcome refused by submit before the stamp, then the same start accepting a corrected return right after). Fixed three existing fixtures that the new floor/testsAdded checks would otherwise have broken: _executor()'s default outcome (was 1-char 't'/'d'), ds3's second-filing fixture (was 'a second claim'/'again', both under the new floor), and ce2/ce3's _file_executor calls (task declares tests.add under regression mode, so the default empty testsAdded now needs an explicit non-empty one to reach the close-time check those cases actually test). Verified the full test suite - and specifically every other test file's file-return/return_problems call sites across the repo (test_audit_task.py, test_commit_task_work.py, test_audit_lookup.py, test_close_phase.py, test__refs.py) - keeps its executor-return fixtures a safe distance above the floor and non-identical, so none needed touching. python3 plugins/audit/tests/test__filed_returns.py --selftest: 70/70 passed. python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest: 258/258 passed. ruff check and vermin -t=3.8- on the touched files: clean. python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --jobs 6 (full tree, in the task's own worktree): 334/334 files ok, 16043 cases, no failures - _filed_returns.py, test__filed_returns.py (70 cases) and test_drive_phase.py (258 cases) all reported ok under that run.
outcome.descriptive: An agent can no longer file a placeholder or empty-testsAdded executor return through drive-phase.py submit - the refusal fires before the stamp is taken, names the field, and writes nothing, so the same start can simply resubmit the real text.

testsAdded: rp13 an outcome whose `technical` and `descriptive` are both the bare word `placeholder` is refused - named for the template word and the identical pair - and so is one that merely falls under the stated floor, before anything is written

rp14 a tdd or regression return with `testsAdded` empty while the task's tests.add names a case is refused by naming `testsAdded`; one that files the case is not, and a gate-only task with no `tests.add` is never asked
ds5p a placeholder outcome is refused by name, before the stamp is taken, and nothing is written
ds5q THE ALLOW TWIN: the same start accepts the corrected return right after the refusal
